description:
BS/MS in Computer Science or technical related education
 5+ years of development of mission critical systems, including server side development
 Expert knowledge and experience in Java
 Expert level knowledge of J2EE and atleast one framework (spring, struts etc) as well as Hibernate/JPA framework
 Expert level understanding of web MVC architectures
 Experience exposing functionality through RESTful interfaces
 Expertise in design/implementation for availability, scalability, reliability and performance
 Expertise in modern database/storage technologies including relational databases (Ex. MySQL) as well as NoSQL databases (Ex. Cassandra, MongoDB)
 Expertise in designing and building web applications and/or web services in a distributed environment
 Experience working in cross-functional teams
 Strong written and oral communication skills, ability to multi-task, establish priorities and meet tight deadlines
 Good to Have:
 

 Front end web application development (HTML 5, CSS 3, Javascript, Jquery, Javascript MVC frameworks)
 Modern web application framework experience (Ruby on Rails, Django)

 J2EE,MVC,RESTful,Python,Jquery 

 Only GC/Citizen
